decision: Reuse a verified current A1-linked secondary Person after primary and Owner fail, before paid secondary Search.

actions.linked_secondary_selected: Run Contact Enrichment for work email and phone, then update the existing Twenty Person.
actions.primary_or_owner_selected: Do not use the deferred secondary fallback.

deduplication: Selection must reference the exact existing Twenty Person ID.
provider_cost_avoidance: The linked-secondary resolution stage performs zero provider calls.
